sample_unit: CT examinations (test set; 446 collected in total)

links.outcome: Failure detection by confidence scoring, measured by area under the risk coverage curve
links.effect: Adding tumor volume and slice thickness to confidence scoring reduced the area under the risk coverage curve from 16.7 to 10.3 and improved failure detection.
links.quote: Incorporating tumor volume and slice thickness into the confidence scoring process improved failure detection, enhanced reliability, and provided valuable insights for refining clinical deployment of automated segmentation algorithms.

unlisted_practices: Metadata-guided confidence scoring (tumor volume, slice thickness) to flag unreliable segmentations
Iterative training with an integrated annotation workflow to refine the training set

screen.reason: Evaluates metadata-guided confidence scoring and risk-coverage thresholds as a failure-detection safeguard to improve segmentation reliability before clinical deployment.
